phase: PHASE 1 — Data Audit and Spatial Readiness (REVISED & OFFICIALLY INTEGRATED)

production_reconciliation.root_cause: Preliminary report table utilized early manual aggregations for Tongkol Krai, Como, Kenyar, Tenggiri, and Marlin. Cell-by-cell re-audit of all 132 rows in Sheet 5 verified exact total of 18,405,261 kg with 0 remaining discrepancy.

fleet_reconciliation.discrepancy_explanation: 387 was the sum of only two classes (<10 GT: 296 + 20-30 GT: 91). True total of all four GT classes in Sheet 2 for 2025 is 443 (<10 GT: 296, 10-<20 GT: 53, 20-<30 GT: 91, >30 GT: 3).

trips_reconciliation.root_cause: Sheet 4 (GT trips) copied the 2014 monthly values (14,802 trips) into 2018, 2019, and 2020. Sheet 3 (Gear trips) recorded actual operational trip fluctuations (18,863; 21,074; 24,575 trips). Sheet 3 is confirmed as the primary operational effort dataset.
